    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []
        self.notes = {}
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self.seq = 0
        self.active_request_id = None
        self.finished_requests = set()
    
    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq += 1
        request_id = self.seq
        self.active_request_id = request_id
        self.loading = True
        self.error = None  # Clear loading errors on begin
        return request_id
    
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        # Reject if not the latest begun request
        if request_id != self.active_request_id:
            return False
        
        # Reject if this request already finished (duplicate)
        if request_id in self.finished_requests:
            return False
        
        # Accept and store rows as a copy
        self.rows = list(rows)
        self.loading = False
        self.finished_requests.add(request_id)
        
        # Preserve notes through all requests
        return True

import copy
from view import View

def test_begin_increases_seq():
    """Test that begin returns monotonically increasing request ids."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    id2 = v.begin("q2")
    id3 = v.begin("q3")
    assert id1 == 1, f"First request should be 1, got {id1}"
    assert id2 == 2, f"Second request should be 2, got {id2}"
    assert id3 == 3, f"Third request should be 3, got {id3}"

def test_finish_accepts_latest():
    """Test that finish only accepts the latest begun request."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    id2 = v.begin("q2")
    
    # Finish with latest request should succeed
    result = v.finish(id2, [[1, 2]])
    assert result == True, "Latest request finish should return True"
    assert v.rows == [[1, 2]], f"Rows should be [[1, 2]], got {v.rows}"
    
    # Finish with older request should fail
    result = v.finish(id1, [[3, 4]])
    assert result == False, "Older request finish should return False"
    assert v.rows == [[1, 2]], f"Rows should still be [[1, 2]], got {v.rows}"

def test_finish_rejects_duplicate():
    """Test that duplicate replies return False."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    
    # First finish succeeds
    result1 = v.finish(id1, [[1]])
    assert result1 == True, "First finish should succeed"
    
    # Second finish with same id should fail (duplicate)
    result2 = v.finish(id1, [[2]])
    assert result2 == False, "Duplicate finish should return False"
    assert v.rows == [[1]], f"Rows should still be [[1]], got {v.rows}"

def test_begin_clears_error():
    """Test that begin clears loading errors."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    
    # Set an error
    v.error = "old error"
    assert v.error == "old error", "Error should be set"
    
    # Begin a new request - should clear error
    v.begin("q2")
    assert v.error is None, "Error should be cleared after begin"

def test_begin_keeps_existing_rows():
    """Test that begin keeps existing rows until valid finish."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    
    # Finish with first request
    v.finish(id1, [[1, 2]])
    assert v.rows == [[1, 2]], f"Rows should be [[1, 2]], got {v.rows}"
    
    # Begin new request - rows should be kept until valid finish
    id2 = v.begin("q2")
    
    # Finish with second request
    result = v.finish(id2, [[3, 4]])
    assert result == True, "Second finish should succeed"
    assert v.rows == [[3, 4]], f"Rows should be [[3, 4]], got {v.rows}"

def test_loading_boolean():
    """Test that loading boolean is exposed and changes correctly."""
    v = View()
    
    # Initially not loading
    assert v.loading == False, "Should not be loading initially"
    
    # Begin makes it loading
    v.begin("q1")
    assert v.loading == True, "Should be loading after begin"
    
    # Finish stops loading
    v.finish(1, [])
    assert v.loading == False, "Should not be loading after finish"

def test_copy_rows():
    """Test that accepted rows are copied."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    
    # Set original rows
    original = [[1], [2], [3]]
    result = v.finish(id1, original)
    assert result == True, "Finish should succeed"
    
    # Modify original after finish
    original[0][0] = 999
    
    # View rows should not be affected (it's a copy)
    assert v.rows == [[1], [2], [3]], f"Rows should be [[1], [2], [3]], got {v.rows}"

def test_preserve_notes():
    """Test that notes are preserved through all requests."""
    v = View()
    
    # Add some notes
    v.notes["job1"] = "note for job 1"
    v.notes["job2"] = "note for job 2"
    assert v.notes == {"job1": "note for job 1", "job2": "note for job 2"}
    
    # Begin new request
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    
    # Finish with data
    v.finish(id1, [[1]])
    
    # Notes should still be preserved
    assert v.notes == {"job1": "note for job 1", "job2": "note for job 2"}
    
    # Begin another request
    id2 = v.begin("q2")
    
    # Finish with more data
    v.finish(id2, [[2]])
    
    # Notes should still be preserved
    assert v.notes == {"job1": "note for job 1", "job2": "note for job 2"}

def test_stale_responses():
    """Test that stale responses are ignored."""
    v = View()
    
    # Begin two requests
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    id2 = v.begin("q2")
    
    # Try to finish with first request (stale)
    result1 = v.finish(id1, [[1]])
    assert result1 == False, "Stale response should return False"
    
    # Finish with second request (latest)
    result2 = v.finish(id2, [[2]])
    assert result2 == True, "Latest response should return True"
    
    # Rows should be from the latest valid finish
    assert v.rows == [[2]], f"Rows should be [[2]], got {v.rows}"

def test_empty_rows():
    """Test that empty rows work correctly."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    result = v.finish(id1, [])
    assert result == True, "Empty rows finish should succeed"
    assert v.rows == [], f"Rows should be [], got {v.rows}"

def test_finish_without_begin():
    """Test that finishing without beginning returns False."""
    v = View()
    # No begin called
    result = v.finish(999, [[1]])
    assert result == False, "Finish without begin should return False"

def test_finish_zero_id():
    """Test that finishing with zero id returns False."""
    v = View()
    id1 = v.begin("q1")
    result = v.finish(0, [[1]])
    assert result == False, "Finish with 0 should return False"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_begin_increases_seq()
    print("test_begin_increases_seq passed")
    
    test_finish_accepts_latest()
    print("test_finish_accepts_latest passed")
    
    test_finish_rejects_duplicate()
    print("test_finish_rejects_duplicate passed")
    
    test_begin_clears_error()
    print("test_begin_clears_error passed")
    
    test_begin_keeps_existing_rows()
    print("test_begin_keeps_existing_rows passed")
    
    test_loading_boolean()
    print("test_loading_boolean passed")
    
    test_copy_rows()
    print("test_copy_rows passed")
    
    test_preserve_notes()
    print("test_preserve_notes passed")
    
    test_stale_responses()
    print("test_stale_responses passed")
    
    test_empty_rows()
    print("test_empty_rows passed")
    
    test_finish_without_begin()
    print("test_finish_without_begin passed")
    
    test_finish_zero_id()
    print("test_finish_zero_id passed")
    
    print("\nAll tests passed!")
